question: T12 (task-78bc0672904da5dc, task-f965eec8e625ed9a, task-d91d6e0d2f550874), after CAP-T12TOPFALL: where do the blocks below a Scrolling block go on a one-step Wave Intensity fall, on the desktop and in the phone view? And which block on the Scrolling block's top row is stretched, not moved? On Blocks Probe at a 1600 by 1000 window, one new section per plan with a new Scrolling block and a second block added after it (a Text block; a Scrolling block in k, l, m, o and q; a Button block in n), made on the desktop (desktop 1/2/3/26 and 1/2/3/10, a Scrolling block 1/2/3/26, a Button 1/2/3/8; phone 1/2/3/10 and 3/2/5/10). Arranged by arrow keys on the selected block ('arr') or by a drag and a bottom-right handle drag ('place', block 0 the Scrolling block, block 1 the second), in the view the plan reads; then the Scrolling block selected, Edit, Design ('open', a read with the panel's Wave value), the presses on Wave Intensity (179 is the press at the range's end, read as 180) or a real ArrowLeft on the range 1.2 s after a press on its thumb, Escape (let go, 'go') and Cmd+Z, a read after each. Desktop: a the Text block 3/2/5/10 (under the foot), 180>150; b 4/2/6/10 (a row below), 180>150; c as a, 150>120; d as a, 180>ArrowLeft; l the second Scrolling block as added (both 1/2/3/26), 150>0; m the same, 90>180>120; o the second Scrolling block 2/2/4/26, 150>0; n the Button block as added, 150>0; p the Scrolling block made 1/2/3/10 (the Text block's area), 150>0; q the second Scrolling block made 1/2/3/14, 150>0. Phone (Mobile View, the frame 428 wide, then back to Desktop View): e the Text block as added (3/2/5/10 there), 180>150; f 4/2/6/10, 180>150; g as e, 180>150>120; h the Text block moved up onto the top row (1/2/3/10, the Scrolling block's area), 90>150>60; i the same, 180>150; j the Text block on the second row (2/2/4/10), 150>0; k the second Scrolling block moved onto the top row (1/2/3/10), 150>0; r the Text block on the top row made 1/2/3/6, 150>0. R1 ran abcdlmon and pqefghijkr, R2 nomldcba and rkjihgfeqp, four edit sessions. Nothing saved: every session left by Exit Without Saving.
readsAre: As CAP-T12TOPFALL: layout of the Scrolling block and every block in its section (me: the Scrolling block; line: its drawing's height; sel: selected; kind: scrolling or other; desktop and phone areas, top in the section and height), the section rows in the view shown, rowSizes, the Scrolling block's height, line (marquee and svg: top in the block and height), Undo and Redo, the panel's ranges; 'wave' is the panel's Wave Intensity value; 'keys' holds d's key states. The read's name is the run, the plan, and the steps in order, '>' between them ('z' is Cmd+Z).
answer: On the desktop a one-step fall moves a block at or under the old foot up with the foot, as a growth moves it down: a, the Text block 3/2/5/10 under the foot, 180 takes it to 7/2/9/10 (the Scrolling block 1/2/7/26), 150 to 6/2/8/10 (1/2/6/26), the section 12 to 11 rows; b, a row below (4/2/6/10), 8/2/10/10 then 7/2/9/10, keeping the row between; c, 150 then 120, 6/2/8/10 to 5/2/7/10 (1/2/5/26, 10 rows); d, 180 then a real ArrowLeft, as a.

So the one-step fall that leaves a block (CAP-T12TOPFALL P, CAP-T12WAVEKEYS K and R: a Text block at 5/2/7/10 stays as the Scrolling block goes 1/2/7/26 to 1/2/6/26, and on to 1/2/5/26 by a second ArrowDown) leaves only a block that starts above the old foot, on the Scrolling block's rows.

In the phone view a one-step fall moves a block under the Scrolling block with the foot: e, the Text block under it (3/2/5/10), 180 takes it to 8/2/10/10 (the Scrolling block 1/2/8/10), 150 to 6/2/8/10 (1/2/6/10, the section 9 to 7 rows); f, a row below (4/2/6/10), 9/2/11/10 then 7/2/9/10; g, 180, 150, then 120 keeps 1/2/6/10 and the Text block 6/2/8/10 (the line ran over its rows, CAP-T12WAVEPHONE).

g's Cmd+Z after 120 gives back 150 with the rows its line takes on a growth, 1/2/7/10 (block 199) and the Text block 7/2/9/10, the section 8 rows, not the 1/2/6/10 the fall left; the next Cmd+Z gives 180 (1/2/8/10), the next the section as built. Not built here.

A block with the Scrolling block's own area is stretched with it, not moved, in either view and of either kind: its top stays, its end follows the foot down as it grows, and it stays as the foot falls. Desktop: l, two Scrolling blocks on 1/2/3/26, 150 takes both to 1/2/6/26, 0 leaves the first 1/2/2/26 and the second 1/2/6/26, the section at 11 rows; m, 90, 180 and 120 take the second to 1/2/5/26, 1/2/7/26 and leave it there (12 rows); p, the Scrolling block made 1/2/3/10 over the Text block's 1/2/3/10: the Text block goes to 1/2/6/10 and stays. Phone: h, the Text block moved onto the top row (both 1/2/3/10): 90, 150 and 60 leave it 1/2/5/10, 1/2/7/10, 1/2/7/10; i, 180 and 150 leave it 1/2/8/10 as the Scrolling block goes 1/2/8/10 then 1/2/6/10 (9 rows kept); k, a second Scrolling block on the top row (1/2/3/10): 1/2/7/10, and it stays as 0 leaves the first at 1/2/2/10.

A block on the top row with another area is moved, as CAP-T12TOPFALL A: q, the second Scrolling block 1/2/3/14 under 1/2/3/26, goes to 4/2/6/14 at 150 and lands on the foot at 0, 2/2/4/14; n, a Button block as added (1/2/3/8), 4/2/6/8 then 2/2/4/8; r, phone, the Text block 1/2/3/6 under 1/2/3/10, 5/2/7/6 then 2/2/4/6. A block on the second row moves the plain way and lands on the foot when that would reach the top row (CAP-T12TOPFALL C): o, the second Scrolling block 2/2/4/26, 5/2/7/26 at 150, 2/2/4/26 at 0; j, phone, the Text block 2/2/4/10, 6/2/8/10 then 2/2/4/10.

Escape keeps every area; each Cmd+Z takes back one step, both blocks and the section rows with it (but g's, above). The other view's areas stay throughout. R1 and R2 read alike in every read, apart from Undo and Redo at a plan's start (Redo stays on from the plan before).

Not read: a phone one-step fall with a block that starts above the old foot; a block that shares the Scrolling block's top and columns but not its end row; a stretched block that was taller than the Scrolling block; two blocks on the Scrolling block's area; a drag through these steps.

localGuesses.written: before the reads, ours on main: every block that shares a column with the Scrolling block and starts on or below its top row follows its foot, by press, key or fall, in both views (P's Text block went up a row)
